name: Bentic
about: Bentic (class 1036), Tenebrae's librarian in East Tenebrae, a student of names and of history; executed when Vividos sends the Avatar for reagents (G[93:1]). INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue.

topics.label: Why did the old word for champion fall out of use?
say: Ah! A question about words! Most people's eyes glaze over at etymology.
A word dies when nobody needs it any more. If the old Pagans had a word for a champion, perhaps they once expected one.
And then, I suppose, they stopped expecting. Or they stopped hoping. The words go first, you see. The hope goes after.
Mind you, that is not for certain. I must make a note of this. Fascinating!
